opis: 45 zadataka (15 lakih, 15 srednjih, 15 teških) nad šemama prodavnica i fakultet, svaki na srpskom i engleskom jeziku.

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži ime i prezime svih kupaca iz Beograda.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the first and last name of all customers from Beograd.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT ime, prezime FROM prodavnica.kupci WHERE grad = 'Beograd'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko proizvoda ima manje od 10 komada na stanju?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many products have fewer than 10 units in stock?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT count(*) FROM prodavnica.proizvodi WHERE kolicina_na_stanju < 10

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži 5 najskupljih proizvoda sa njihovom cenom.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the 5 most expensive products with their price.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT naziv, cena FROM prodavnica.proizvodi ORDER BY cena DESC LIMIT 5

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji zaposleni nemaju nadređenog?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which employees have no manager?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT ime, prezime FROM prodavnica.zaposleni WHERE menadzer_id IS NULL

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži nazive kategorija koje u imenu sadrže reč oprema.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the names of categories whose name contains the word oprema.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT naziv FROM prodavnica.kategorije WHERE naziv ILIKE '%oprema%'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko porudžbina je otkazano?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many orders were cancelled?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT count(*) FROM prodavnica.porudzbine WHERE status = 'otkazana'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži kupce koji su se registrovali tokom 2021. godine.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the customers who registered during 2021.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT ime, prezime, datum_registracije FROM prodavnica.kupci WHERE datum_registracije BETWEEN DATE '2021-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Kolika je prosečna plata zaposlenih u sektoru IT?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: What is the average salary of employees in the IT department?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT avg(plata) FROM prodavnica.zaposleni WHERE sektor = 'IT'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži broj indeksa, ime i prezime studenata koji su ispisani.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the index number, first and last name of students who withdrew.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT broj_indeksa, ime, prezime FROM fakultet.studenti WHERE status = 'ispisan'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko ima profesora u zvanju redovni profesor?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many professors hold the title redovni profesor?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT count(*) FROM fakultet.profesori WHERE zvanje = 'redovni profesor'

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži šifru, naziv i broj bodova predmeta koji nose više od 6 ESPB.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the code, name and credits of courses worth more than 6 ECTS.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT sifra, naziv, espb FROM fakultet.predmeti WHERE espb > 6

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji smerovi traju 4 godine?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which study programs last 4 years?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT naziv FROM fakultet.smerovi WHERE trajanje_godina = 4

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži 5 najstarijih katedri po godini osnivanja.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the 5 oldest departments by year of founding.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT naziv, godina_osnivanja FROM fakultet.katedre ORDER BY godina_osnivanja LIMIT 5

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko studenata je upisano 2022. godine?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many students enrolled in 2022?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT count(*) FROM fakultet.studenti WHERE godina_upisa = 2022

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko prijava ispita nema upisanu ocenu?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many exam registrations have no grade recorded?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT count(*) FROM fakultet.prijave_ispita WHERE ocena IS NULL

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži ukupnu zaradu po kategoriji proizvoda, od najveće ka najmanjoj.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show total revenue per product category, from highest to lowest.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.naziv, SUM(s.kolicina * s.cena) AS zarada FROM prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s JOIN prodavnica.proizvodi p ON p.proizvod_id = s.proizvod_id JOIN prodavnica.kategorije k ON k.kategorija_id = p.kategorija_id GROUP BY k.naziv ORDER BY zarada DESC

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko porudžbina ima svaki kupac iz Novog Sada?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many orders does each customer from Novi Sad have?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.ime, k.prezime, count(*) AS broj FROM prodavnica.kupci k JOIN prodavnica.porudzbine p ON p.kupac_id = k.kupac_id WHERE k.grad = 'Novi Sad' GROUP BY k.kupac_id, k.ime, k.prezime

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži prosečnu ocenu po proizvodu, ali samo za proizvode sa najmanje 3 recenzije.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the average rating per product, but only for products with at least 3 reviews.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT p.naziv, round(avg(r.ocena), 2) AS prosek, count(*) AS broj_recenzija FROM prodavnica.recenzije r JOIN prodavnica.proizvodi p ON p.proizvod_id = r.proizvod_id GROUP BY p.proizvod_id, p.naziv HAVING count(*) >= 3

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži broj porudžbina po mesecu u 2024. godini, gde je mesec broj od 1 do 12.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the number of orders per month in 2024, where the month is a number from 1 to 12.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM datum_porudzbine) AS mesec, count(*) AS broj FROM prodavnica.porudzbine WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM datum_porudzbine) = 2024 GROUP BY 1

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koje kurirske službe su isporučile najviše pošiljki? Broji samo isporučene.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which couriers delivered the most shipments? Count only delivered ones.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT kurirska_sluzba, count(*) AS broj FROM prodavnica.isporuke WHERE datum_isporuke IS NOT NULL GROUP BY kurirska_sluzba ORDER BY broj DESC

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži ime i prezime svakog zaposlenog zajedno sa imenom i prezimenom njegovog menadžera.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show each employee's first and last name together with their manager's first and last name.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT z.ime, z.prezime, m.ime AS ime_menadzera, m.prezime AS prezime_menadzera FROM prodavnica.zaposleni z JOIN prodavnica.zaposleni m ON m.zaposleni_id = z.menadzer_id

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko različitih proizvoda je naručeno iz svake kategorije?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many distinct products were ordered from each category?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.naziv, count(DISTINCT s.proizvod_id) AS broj FROM prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s JOIN prodavnica.proizvodi p ON p.proizvod_id = s.proizvod_id JOIN prodavnica.kategorije k ON k.kategorija_id = p.kategorija_id GROUP BY k.naziv

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži 10 kupaca sa najvećom ukupnom potrošnjom.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the 10 customers with the highest total spending.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.ime, k.prezime, SUM(s.kolicina * s.cena) AS potrosnja FROM prodavnica.kupci k JOIN prodavnica.porudzbine p ON p.kupac_id = k.kupac_id JOIN prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s ON s.porudzbina_id = p.porudzbina_id GROUP BY k.kupac_id, k.ime, k.prezime ORDER BY potrosnja DESC LIMIT 10

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži prosečnu ocenu po smeru.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the average grade per study program.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT sm.naziv, round(avg(pi.ocena), 2) AS prosek FROM fakultet.studenti st JOIN fakultet.smerovi sm ON sm.smer_id = st.smer_id JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.student_id = st.student_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id WHERE pi.ocena IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sm.naziv

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko studenata ima svaki smer?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many students does each study program have?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT sm.naziv, count(*) AS broj FROM fakultet.studenti st JOIN fakultet.smerovi sm ON sm.smer_id = st.smer_id GROUP BY sm.naziv

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži predmete čija je prolaznost ispod 50 procenata.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the courses whose pass rate is below 50 percent.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT p.naziv, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen) / count(*), 1) AS prolaznost FROM fakultet.predmeti p JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.predmet_id = p.predmet_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id GROUP BY p.predmet_id, p.naziv HAVING 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen) / count(*) < 50

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koliko predmeta predaje svaki profesor?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: How many courses does each professor teach?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT pr.ime, pr.prezime, count(*) AS broj FROM fakultet.profesori pr JOIN fakultet.predmeti p ON p.profesor_id = pr.profesor_id GROUP BY pr.profesor_id, pr.ime, pr.prezime

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži broj prijava po ispitnom roku.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the number of exam registrations per exam period.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT r.naziv, r.skolska_godina, count(*) AS broj FROM fakultet.ispitni_rokovi r JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.rok_id = r.rok_id GROUP BY r.rok_id, r.naziv, r.skolska_godina

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži studente čiji je prosek ocena veći od 8.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the students whose average grade is higher than 8.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT st.ime, st.prezime, round(avg(pi.ocena), 2) AS prosek FROM fakultet.studenti st JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.student_id = st.student_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id WHERE pi.ocena IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.student_id, st.ime, st.prezime HAVING avg(pi.ocena) > 8

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži svaku katedru i broj smerova koji joj pripadaju.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show each department and the number of study programs belonging to it.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.naziv, count(s.smer_id) AS broj_smerova FROM fakultet.katedre k LEFT JOIN fakultet.smerovi s ON s.katedra_id = k.katedra_id GROUP BY k.naziv

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Za svaku kategoriju prikaži njen najskuplji proizvod.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: For each category show its most expensive product.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH rang AS ( SELECT p.naziv, p.cena, k.naziv AS kategorija, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kategorija_id ORDER BY p.cena DESC, p.proizvod_id) AS r FROM prodavnica.proizvodi p JOIN prodavnica.kategorije k ON k.kategorija_id = p.kategorija_id) SELECT kategorija, naziv, cena FROM rang WHERE r = 1

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji proizvodi nikada nisu naručeni?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which products have never been ordered?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT p.naziv FROM prodavnica.proizvodi p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s WHERE s.proizvod_id = p.proizvod_id)

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži zaradu po mesecima u 2024. godini i kumulativnu zaradu od početka godine.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show revenue per month in 2024 together with the running total from the start of the year.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH m AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', p.datum_porudzbine) AS mesec, SUM(s.kolicina * s.cena) AS zarada FROM prodavnica.porudzbine p JOIN prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s ON s.porudzbina_id = p.porudzbina_id WHERE p.datum_porudzbine >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND p.datum_porudzbine < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT mesec, zarada, SUM(zarada) OVER (ORDER BY mesec) AS kumulativno FROM m ORDER BY mesec

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji kupci su naručivali proizvode iz više od 5 različitih kategorija?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which customers ordered products from more than 5 different categories?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.ime, k.prezime, count(DISTINCT p.kategorija_id) AS broj_kategorija FROM prodavnica.kupci k JOIN prodavnica.porudzbine o ON o.kupac_id = k.kupac_id JOIN prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s ON s.porudzbina_id = o.porudzbina_id JOIN prodavnica.proizvodi p ON p.proizvod_id = s.proizvod_id GROUP BY k.kupac_id, k.ime, k.prezime HAVING count(DISTINCT p.kategorija_id) > 5

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Za svakog zaposlenog prikaži broj obrađenih porudžbina i odstupanje od proseka svih zaposlenih.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: For each employee show the number of processed orders and the deviation from the average across all employees.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH po_zaposlenom AS ( SELECT z.zaposleni_id, z.ime, z.prezime, count(p.porudzbina_id) AS broj FROM prodavnica.zaposleni z LEFT JOIN prodavnica.porudzbine p ON p.zaposleni_id = z.zaposleni_id GROUP BY z.zaposleni_id, z.ime, z.prezime) SELECT ime, prezime, broj, round(broj - avg(broj) OVER (), 2) AS odstupanje FROM po_zaposlenom

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koje kategorije imaju prosečnu cenu veću od prosečne cene svih proizvoda?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which categories have an average price higher than the average price of all products?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT k.naziv, round(avg(p.cena), 2) AS prosek FROM prodavnica.proizvodi p JOIN prodavnica.kategorije k ON k.kategorija_id = p.kategorija_id GROUP BY k.naziv HAVING avg(p.cena) > (SELECT avg(cena) FROM prodavnica.proizvodi)

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži tri najprodavanija proizvoda u svakoj kategoriji, po ukupnoj naručenoj količini.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the three best-selling products in each category, by total ordered quantity.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH prodaja AS ( SELECT p.proizvod_id, p.naziv, p.kategorija_id, SUM(s.kolicina) AS komada FROM prodavnica.stavke_porudzbine s JOIN prodavnica.proizvodi p ON p.proizvod_id = s.proizvod_id GROUP BY p.proizvod_id, p.naziv, p.kategorija_id), rang AS ( SELECT prodaja.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kategorija_id ORDER BY komada DESC, proizvod_id) AS r FROM prodaja) SELECT k.naziv AS kategorija, rang.naziv, rang.komada FROM rang JOIN prodavnica.kategorije k ON k.kategorija_id = rang.kategorija_id WHERE rang.r <= 3

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji kupci su naručivali tokom 2023. godine, a nijednom tokom 2024. godine?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which customers placed orders during 2023 but none during 2024?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT kupac_id FROM prodavnica.porudzbine WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM datum_porudzbine) = 2023 EXCEPT SELECT kupac_id FROM prodavnica.porudzbine WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM datum_porudzbine) = 2024

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Za svaki smer prikaži studenta sa najboljim prosekom.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: For each study program show the student with the best average grade.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH prosek AS ( SELECT st.student_id, st.ime, st.prezime, st.smer_id, avg(pi.ocena) AS p FROM fakultet.studenti st JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.student_id = st.student_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id WHERE pi.ocena IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.student_id, st.ime, st.prezime, st.smer_id), rang AS ( SELECT prosek.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY smer_id ORDER BY p DESC, student_id) AS r FROM prosek) SELECT s.naziv AS smer, rang.ime, rang.prezime, round(rang.p, 2) AS prosek FROM rang JOIN fakultet.smerovi s ON s.smer_id = rang.smer_id WHERE rang.r = 1

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji studenti nisu položili nijedan ispit?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which students have not passed a single exam?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT st.broj_indeksa, st.ime, st.prezime FROM fakultet.studenti st WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fakultet.upisi_predmeta u JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id WHERE u.student_id = st.student_id AND pi.polozen)

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji predmeti imaju prosečnu ocenu iznad proseka svog smera?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which courses have an average grade above the average of their own study program?
zadaci.goldSql: WITH po_predmetu AS ( SELECT p.predmet_id, p.naziv, p.smer_id, avg(pi.ocena) AS prosek FROM fakultet.predmeti p JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.predmet_id = p.predmet_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id WHERE pi.ocena IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.predmet_id, p.naziv, p.smer_id) SELECT naziv, round(prosek, 2) AS prosek FROM po_predmetu pp WHERE prosek > (SELECT avg(x.prosek) FROM po_predmetu x WHERE x.smer_id = pp.smer_id)

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Rangiraj smerove po prolaznosti na ispitima, od najveće ka najmanjoj.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Rank the study programs by exam pass rate, from highest to lowest.
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT s.naziv, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen) / count(*), 1) AS prolaznost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen) / count(*) DESC) AS rang FROM fakultet.smerovi s JOIN fakultet.studenti st ON st.smer_id = s.smer_id JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.student_id = st.student_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id GROUP BY s.naziv ORDER BY rang

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Prikaži broj položenih ispita po školskoj godini i razliku u odnosu na prethodnu godinu.
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Show the number of passed exams per academic year and the difference from the previous year.
zadaci.goldSql: WITH g AS ( SELECT u.skolska_godina, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen) AS polozeno FROM fakultet.upisi_predmeta u JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id GROUP BY u.skolska_godina) SELECT skolska_godina, polozeno, polozeno - LAG(polozeno) OVER (ORDER BY skolska_godina) AS razlika FROM g ORDER BY skolska_godina

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji profesori ne predaju nijedan predmet?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which professors do not teach any course?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT pr.ime, pr.prezime FROM fakultet.profesori pr WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fakultet.predmeti p WHERE p.profesor_id = pr.profesor_id)

zadaci.pitanjeSr: Koji studenti su položili sve predmete koje su upisali?
zadaci.pitanjeEn: Which students passed every course they enrolled in?
zadaci.goldSql: SELECT st.broj_indeksa, st.ime, st.prezime FROM fakultet.studenti st JOIN fakultet.upisi_predmeta u ON u.student_id = st.student_id JOIN fakultet.prijave_ispita pi ON pi.upis_id = u.upis_id GROUP BY st.student_id, st.broj_indeksa, st.ime, st.prezime HAVING count(*) = count(*) FILTER (WHERE pi.polozen)
